'''Return to Consciousness''' was a [[Force power/Legends#Control|Control]] and [[Force power/Legends#Alter|Alter]] [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] to return to consciousness after sustaining an injury or effect that had knocked them out.<ref name="RPG" /> The individual could also cause another to return to consciousness, although they could not do this while they, themselves, were unconscious.<ref name="RC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref>
